syntheticControls.actualE2eDisclaimer: Actual UI/E2E runs may NOT use fault gates, synthetic delays, or SDK fallbacks. All hooks remain strictly passive read-only telemetry.

controls.name: scopeExcludesUnrelated
controls.description: Operations on unmanaged objects or uninstrumented services proceed unmodified without polluting telemetry or throwing

controls.name: recordsWithoutPrivatePayloads
controls.description: Captured errors contain sanitized route and SQL state without exposing JWT tokens, passwords, emails, query params, or raw SQL text

controls.name: preservesExactErrorIdentityAndReturns
controls.description: Injected synthetic error instance is rethrown with strict object identity equality (caughtErr === syntheticFault) and custom properties intact; successful returns remain identical

controls.name: survivesFileWriteFailureWithoutAppChange
controls.description: Simulated disk full or EIO in observer file writer increments failureCount without crashing application or altering return values
assertions: app operation succeeds despite writer error
observer logs failure internally without unhandled throw

controls.name: restorationOnNormalCloseAndStartupFailure
controls.description: Invoking stop function cleanly restores all prototypes (pg.Pool, pg.Client, RoomServiceClient, Services), removes event listeners, stops timers, and is idempotent

controls.name: actualCompiledOwnersBinding
controls.description: Binds cleanly to current Build 13 compiled classes and methods (CallsService, PublishingService, CallLifecycleService, RoomsService, PlaySessionsService)

controls.name: errorOriginDistinctionPgVsSdk
controls.description: Correctly categorizes and distinguishes PG statement timeout (57014), PG connection limit (53300), PG pool acquire timeout, and LiveKit SDK 503 / Twirp unavailable
